text: Yes, I've got a busy day today. I hope you have a good day. See you later.
Excuse me, is this seat taken?
No, it's free. You're welcome to sit.
Good afternoon. What can I get you?
Good afternoon. I'd like a coffee, please. With milk but with no sugar. To take away.
Hello! I'm sorry but I can't talk at the moment. I need to go home now. Can we talk tomorrow?
Yes, very. I'm very tired now. Good night. I'll see you tomorrow.
My name is Anna. And you?
Pleased to meet you too. Where are you from?
I'm from France. I've been here for two years.
I'm a nurse, at the hospital just round the corner. And you?
Yes, of course. I'm a nurse. I work at the hospital. It's near here. And what do you do?
How interesting. Well, lovely to meet you.
